description: React component providing authentication context and related functions for user login, logout, registration, and profile updates; manages user state and communicates with backend API.

methods.name: AuthProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component that provides authentication state and functions to its children.

methods.name: useAuth()
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login process, updates user state, and displays notifications.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, updates user state, and displays notifications.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, clears user state, and notifies.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates user profile information and notifies.

methods.name: isOrganizer
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the 'organizer' role.
